exposure: Gestational age at birth (late preterm vs early term)
outcome: Prevalence of late preterm and early term birth
cohort: Single births in 14 public hospitals in Portugal in 2013
finding: The study found that the prevalence of late preterm and early term birth in Portugal is comparable to other published series, with cesarean section rates higher in late preterm births and neonatal complications more frequent in late preterm neonates.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was higher in late preterm (39.1%) than in early term (26.4%) births.
gest_age: Late preterm (34-36 weeks) and early term (37-38 weeks)
